info.name: CNF Submit MIGO - delivery referenced, PO-free
info.description:
Reviewed 2026-09-01. Direct call to the standard SAP Material Document API for delivery-referenced movement 101. PO Number and PO Item are deliberately omitted. Material, receiving plant, storage location, quantity and unit remain explicit technical inputs until backend derivation exists.

Run only 01 token fetch, then 02 business POST. No MIGO verification GET. A successful POST must directly return MaterialDocument and MaterialDocumentYear.

Historical evidence: material document 5007138616 / 2026 was created by the earlier PO-plus-delivery request against delivery 9004953150/000010. That delivery has already been received; do not reuse it. The earlier collections remain preserved in the neighboring original folder and in version control. The PO-free request still requires an approved fresh delivery and live proof.

Standard SAP repeatability is requested using RequestID and RepeatabilityCreation HTTP headers. The local guard is NOT server-side protection. DS4/200 setup completed on 2026-08-31; QS4/700 setup and live posting replay/concurrency proof remain pending.

Select the matching Reviewed environment. Fill an approved test case, use a stable submissionId, and set the confirmation to YES only immediately before a deliberate posting. Never clear local history to resolve an uncertain outcome.

Use trusted HTTPS and keep cookies enabled. Do not share populated passwords, tokens, cookies or local submission history.

request.description:
REAL SAP WRITE. Use only an approved fresh delivery with PGI completed and MIGO pending.

This request is PO-free: do not send PurchaseOrder or PurchaseOrderItem. Supply delivery/item plus the technical posting values Material, receiving Plant, Storage Location, Quantity and Unit. Use GoodsMovementRefDocType B and movement 101. A successful POST returns MaterialDocument and MaterialDocumentYear; no second GET is required.

Set submissionId to a unique GUID ONCE per business submission, fill all inputs, fetch the token, then set confirmSubmitMIGO=YES. The script consumes YES before dispatch. The GUID is sent as the standard SAP RequestID header, not an entity property.

Local history skips previously attempted submissions in this environment. Skipping produces no new HTTP response; inspect the Postman Console and saved result.

Requires configured SAP Gateway idempotent services. DS4/200 was initialized on 2026-08-31; QS4/700 setup and live posting replay/concurrency proof remain pending. Never remove the repeatability headers to bypass a 412 or missing-configuration error.

The local guard is NOT atomic across runtimes. Backend protection depends on SAP configuration and its finite retention window. Only RepeatabilityResult=supported plus a valid POST document result passes verification.

For deliberate sequential QA replay only: after Basis confirms retention, set verifiedReplayWindowSeconds (1-300). Inside that window after verified success, keep all inputs and submissionId unchanged, set confirmRepeatSameSubmission=YES and confirmSubmitMIGO=YES. Do not use QA replay for uncertain, failed or expired attempts.
